spans.s:
शीघ्र a. Quick, rapid, speedy;
बिब्रन्मणिं मंडलचारशीघ्रः

.
--घ्रः Conjunction (in astr.).
--घ्रं ind. Quickly, swiftly, rapidly.
--Comp.
--उच्चः conjunction (in
astr.).
--कारिन् a. expeditions,
quick.
--कोपिन् a. choleric, irascible.
--चेतनः a dog.
--बुद्धि a. acute,
sharp-witted.
--लंघन a. going
rapidly, swift of foot; Ghaṭ. 8.
--वेधिन
m. a good archer.

To become
quick or rapid.
--2 To hasten.

शीघ्रिन् a.
1 Speedy, expeditious.
--2 Making haste in pronunciation,
pronouncing very rapidly; Śik. 32.

शीघ्रिय a. Quick.
--यः
1 N. of
Viṣṇu.
--2 Of Śiva.
--3 The
fighting of cats.
